title: ParameterModelBase / PropertyModel / SelectorModel / ApiExplorerModel / BindingInfo
meaning: ParameterModelBase is shared base metadata for parameter-like model elements.
PropertyModel represents controller/page/model properties that can participate in binding/metadata.
SelectorModel represents route/action selection metadata including attributes, endpoint metadata and action constraints.
ApiExplorerModel controls API explorer/OpenAPI visibility, grouping and naming metadata.
BindingInfo contains model binding metadata such as binding source, binder model name and binder type.
boundary_notes: R03 covers the main controller/action/parameter object graph.
R04 is the late metadata layer that conventions often mutate for binding, routes and API explorer behavior.
